issues.description: The Bitmap24 class header in the template repository does not declare a default (no-argument) constructor, but the template implementation defines Bitmap24::Bitmap24() and the solution header declares a default constructor. This mismatch between the class declaration and its implementation (and between template and solution headers) can cause compilation errors or confuse students about which constructors are available.
issues.suggestedFix: Declare the default constructor in the template header to match the implementation (e.g. add 'Bitmap24();' to example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp), or remove the out-of-class definition of the default constructor from example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp and only keep constructors that are declared in the header. Ensure template and solution headers match to avoid compilation failures.
